title: Five habits that make an agent run reproducible under real load
points: Pin the model id, because a floating alias silently changes the system under test
Record the whole tool surface — a tool added later quietly rewrites your history
Log the prompt that actually ran, never the template meant to have produced it
Capture exit state per step, because a swallowed failure reads exactly like success
Keep the seed and the retry count, or an ordinary flake looks like a real regression
